text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 3% over the past day, with Solana showing slightly more pressure, suggesting mild profit-taking rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed index remains solidly in greed territory at 73, and Bitcoin dominance holding at 59% indicates confidence in the large-cap narrative without major flight to safety. The $97B in 24-hour volume is moderate for this price level, consistent with consolidation rather than capitulation or euphoria-driven breakout.
